title: Canonical bounded coefficient unit and etale exceptional identification
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient setting $P$ and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$, $n\ge1$, of [def-pur-conventions]. Work in the constant-$A$ module derived categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites with comparison $C_T=\nu_T^*$ and its derived adjunction unit [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. For every scheme $V$, the comparison image $C_V(A_V[0])$ is bounded constructible [def-sfb-bounded-constructible-complexes]; define $\mathbf1_V$ in the bounded constructible category by this object with its constructibility proof. This is the coefficient object supplied to the standing exceptional composition [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition].

Let $e:U\to X$ be etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], separated [def-weil-proper-morphism] and compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable], with $U$ and $X$ Noetherian, meaning locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] with a finite affine cover. Let $K\in D(X_{et},A)$ be bounded below, and let $N$ be a normalized compact-support presentation [def-sp-etale-compact-support-normalization]. Define the canonical isomorphism $\rho_{e,K}:Re^!C_XK\xrightarrow{\sim}Le^*C_XK$ as follows. Take $N$'s counit-preserving adjunction isomorphism from the ordinary exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] to ordinary inverse image. Before it insert the inverse comparison-adjunction unit at $K$, mapped by the ordinary exceptional functor. After it insert the inverse comparison from derived ordinary pullback to the derived functor of the exact ordinary inverse image. Apply $C_U$ to this composite, then the inverse canonical pullback/site comparison of [thm-pur-dnc-invariance]. The unit is invertible on the stipulated bounded-below $K$, and $N$ determines its adjunction isomorphism by its counit; neither an arbitrary map nor an orientation is chosen.
